item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of reflection and check-ins built into it, and that kind of mental work runs better on a hydrated brain. Even mild dehydration dulls focus and shortens patience. So don't leave water to chance. Tie it to moments you already have planned: a glass with each check-in, one before your walk, and one with dinner. Action: pour a full glass of water right now and finish it.
